details.title: Goal-Oriented Communications
details.description: Manage a software development team implementing C++ based goal-oriented communications algorithms for real-time embedded systems. Research and develop high performance versions of the state-of-the-art Identification codes for 6G communications systems.

details.title: GNU Radio WLAN OFDM Transceiver
details.description: Devised a GNU Radio based WLAN OFDM transceiver to demonstrate the ID codes library schemes in a real world environment.

details.title: 5G-NR Neural Receiver
details.description: Developed Python and C based software tools to train and integrate low complexity Deep Learning based models for a 5G-NR Neural Receiver in a real-time CUDA GPU environment, using TensorFlow/Keras, NVIDIA TensorRT, Nvidia Sionna, LabView and ONNX for NI Ettus SDRs and C-based Open Air Interface to improve SNR gain.
details.languages: RF Deep-Learning TensorFlow ONNX Python C

details.title: Digital Predistortion for RF Power Amplifiers
details.description: Developed a training and validation framework for Generative AI models including RNNs and LSTM based Digital Predistortion algorithms for RF Power Amplifiers in TensorFlow/Keras, to validate a Digital Twin PoC and improve the energy efficiency of PAs.

details.title: Research Tooling
details.description: Focus on AI/ML-based communication systems and research on suitable test systems. Managed efficient storage, loading and tagging of large datasets exceeding hundreds of gigabytes. Assisted the presentation of research results at internal and external events.

details.title: Master Thesis Work
details.description: Developed a Link-layer simulator in Python compliant with IEEE 802.11a/p OFDM. Trained and evaluated various Deep Learning models in TensorFlow and PyTorch including CNN and ResNet based models.

details.title: Channel Estimation and Machine Learning
details.description: Implemented Least-squares and Minimum Mean-squared error and other various Channel estimation techniques for Wireless access in Vehicular environments using TensorFlow and PyTorch. Used GPU for batched algorithm implementation and parallel code execution.

company: Fraunhofer Institute for Integrated Circuits IIS

details.title: Smart Sensing and Analytics
details.description: MSc. Internship, built a Scikit-Learn and TensorFlow based Machine-Learning pipeline for classification of LOS/NLOS 5G and GNSS signal to further enhance positioning algorithm accuracy. Created Jupyter notebooks for ML-pipeline and documented data preprocessing. Performed ANOVA testing and PCA for feature selection. Migrated code for Kalman filter from MATLAB into python and ran unit-tests to verify and debug code execution. Optimized ML models including SVM, k-NN, Decision Trees and Deep Neural Networks.

details.title: Sensor Fusion and Localization
details.description: Designed a new Positioning Reference Signal for 5G (3GPP Release 16), implemented and validated it as OTDOA PRS, and compared its positioning accuracy with LTE-based OTDOA multilateration (PRS Rel.16 NR vs Rel.15 LTE) under AWGN and LOS vs NLOS channel conditions. Implemented a MATLAB simulation using a statistical channel model and a Ray-tracing model of an Indoor Office environment. Added a PRS module to the company codebase using a CI/CD pipeline. Built a GUI to visualize real-time TDOA simulation with mobile base stations.

details.title: 5G Testbed and Hybrid Positioning
details.description: Assisted a team in developing a testbed for 5G - New Radio signalling. Preprocessed Bayern state survey data to generate a 3D model of the city for channel modelling. Executed moving and coverage simulations for 5G and GNSS networks. Performed remote-controlled tests using Sim-Gen via python scripts over TCP/IP for GNSS and 5G hybrid positioning.
details.languages: Python MATLAB SketchUp Blender Spirent SimGEN Oktal-SE SE-NAV

team: Cognitive Science Lab - Prof. Dr. Adele Diedrich

details.title: Monte-Carlo Simulations
details.description: Developed and debugged a series of Monte-Carlo simulations in MATLAB for psychology experiments: MAAS model and Multi-stage sequential sampling models with finite or infinite horizon and variable boundaries. Implemented tests to verify the correct logic of developed simulations.
